caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wall and column, characterized by vibrant colors and detailed ornamentation. Centered is a decorative column with a green rectangular base and shaft, and a capital featuring volutes in green with yellow edging. The shaft of the column contains an intricate design with red and white swirling patterns, enclosed by yellow, green, and blue borders, and adorned with a flower and blue garlands. The background wall is divided into two main sections: the lower section has a marbled pattern in hues of pink, red, and beige, while the upper section is mostly white, intercepted by a narrow, horizontal yellow-and-black border. Above the column, the frieze is adorned with geometric and floral motifs in colors such as red, blue, yellow, black, and white, and features a repetitive pattern with a stylized wave and checkered design. Shadows cast on the wall suggest depth and light direction. The entire scene is rendered on an off-white sheet, and the artist’s signature is visible at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Painted Wall Decoration, Detail of Pilaster
